messages.自分を含む味方を回復しつつ、敵に出血・呪い・釘を撒く、嫉妬斬撃の出血向け回復広域: A multi-target Envy Slash healing E.G.O for Bleed teams that heals allies, including herself, while spreading Bleed, Curse, and Nails on enemies.
**Healing**: After the attack, heals herself and the 2 allies with the lowest current HP ratio by 12.5% of her max HP (15% at Threadspin Ⅳ). She can heal herself. At Threadspin Ⅳ, with 4 or more Envy Resonance, one more ally is healed.
messages.回復量の上乗せ: 解析Ⅲから、回復対象のマイナス効果が多いほど回復量が増える(Ⅲ: **Healing bonus**: From Threadspin Ⅲ, healing increases the more negative effects the recipient has (2.5% per 2 types at Ⅲ, per 1 type at Ⅳ; up to 7.5% at Ⅲ and 10% at Ⅳ).
messages.出血・呪い・釘: 的中時に出血2(Ⅲは3、Ⅳは4)と呪い2(Ⅳは3)、表面的中時: **Bleed, Curse, and Nails**: Inflicts 2 Bleed (3 at Ⅲ, 4 at Ⅳ) and 2 Curse (3 at Ⅳ) on hit, and 2 Nails (3 at Ⅳ) on Heads Hit. Nails is a special Bleed that inflicts Bleed every turn.
messages.パッシブ「胸に突き刺さった鉄のくい」: 基本攻撃スキルで出血を付与すると防御レベ: **Passive — Iron Stake against the Heart**: When a basic attack skill inflicts Bleed, it also inflicts 1 Defense Level Down, plus 2 more Bleed if the target already has Bleed (once per turn each). When an ally takes HP damage from an enemy, it inflicts 1 Curse (twice per turn).
messages.出血編成で、出血を配りつつ味方を回復する場面に使う。パッシブは意識しなくても出血: Use it in Bleed teams when you want to spread Bleed while healing allies. The passive triggers in Bleed teams without any special effort.
messages.2コインで合計威力の幅が広く、精神力が高いほど表が出やすいので、精神消耗25を踏: With 2 Coins, its total power varies widely, and higher SP makes Heads more likely, so use it with the 25 Sanity cost in mind.
messages.必要資源は嫉妬4・色欲2・傲慢1。嫉妬に偏る。: It requires 4 Envy, 2 Lust, and 1 Pride, skewed toward Envy.
messages.Ⅱ: パッシブが解放される。効果が優秀なので早めに解放したい。: **Ⅱ**: Unlocks the passive. Its effect is excellent, so unlock it early.
messages.Ⅲ: 出血3、回復量の上乗せが加わる。: **Ⅲ**: Adds 3 Bleed and the healing bonus.
messages.Ⅳ: 基本威力6→8、回復15%、出血4・呪い3・釘3、嫉妬共鳴4で回復対象+1: **Ⅳ**: Base Power 6→8, 15% healing, 4 Bleed, 3 Curse, 3 Nails, and +1 healing target at 4 Envy Resonance.
messages.ラ・マンチャランドの姫: 出血を付与するスキルを持ち、色欲(S3)・傲慢(S1): **[The Princess of La Manchaland](persona:0911)**: Has Bleed-inflicting skills and supplies all of the required Lust (S3), Pride (S1), and Envy (S2).
messages.薬指野獣派ドーセント: S2・S3が出血を付与し、嫉妬(S2)・色欲(S3)の資: **[The Ring Fauvist Docent](persona:0915)**: S2 and S3 inflict Bleed, and she supplies Envy (S2) and Lust (S3) resources.
